abilities.Symbiosis: If an ally uses its item, this Pokemon gives its item to that ally immediately.
abilities.Fairy Aura: While this Pokemon is active, a Fairy move used by any Pokemon has 1.33x power.
abilities.Grass Pelt: If Grassy Terrain is active, this Pokemon's Defense is multiplied by 1.5.
abilities.Stance Change: If Aegislash, changes Forme to Blade before attacks and Shield before King's Shield.
abilities.Aroma Veil: Protects user/allies from Attract, Disable, Encore, Heal Block, Taunt, and Torment.
abilities.Sweet Veil: This Pokemon and its allies cannot fall asleep; those already asleep do not wake up.
abilities.Suction Cups: This Pokemon cannot be forced to switch out by another Pokemon's attack or item.
abilities.Gooey: Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon have their Speed lowered by 1 stage.
abilities.Harvest: If last item used is a Berry, 50% chance to restore it each end of turn. 100% in Sun.
abilities.Long Reach: This Pokemon's attacks do not make contact with the target.
abilities.Liquid Voice: This Pokemon's sound-based moves become Water type.
abilities.Vital Spirit: This Pokemon cannot fall asleep. Gaining this Ability while asleep cures it.
abilities.Merciless: This Pokemon's attacks are critical hits if the target is poisoned.
abilities.Stamina: This Pokemon's Defense is raised by 1 stage after it is damaged by a move.
abilities.Water Bubble: This Pokemon's Water power is 2x; it can't be burned; Fire power against it is halved.
abilities.Corrosion: This Pokemon can poison or badly poison a Pokemon regardless of its typing.
abilities.Queenly Majesty: This Pokemon and its allies are protected from opposing priority moves.
abilities.Receiver: This Pokemon copies the Ability of an ally that faints.
abilities.Emergency Exit: This Pokemon switches out when it reaches 1/2 or less of its maximum HP.
abilities.Disguise: (Mimikyu only) The first hit it takes is blocked, and it takes 1/8 HP damage instead.
abilities.Berserk: This Pokemon's Sp. Atk is raised by 1 when it reaches 1/2 or less of its max HP.
abilities.Grassy Surge: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Grassy Terrain.
abilities.Libero: This Pokemon's type changes to the type of the move it is using. Once per switch-in.
abilities.Mirror Armor: If this Pokemon's stat stages would be lowered, the attacker's are lowered instead.
abilities.Stakeout: This Pokemon's offensive stat is doubled against a target that switched in this turn.
abilities.Ripen: When this Pokemon eats certain Berries, the effects are doubled.
abilities.Hustle: This Pokemon's Attack is 1.5x and accuracy of its physical attacks is 0.8x.
abilities.Sand Spit: When this Pokemon is hit by an attack, the effect of Sandstorm begins.
abilities.Punk Rock: This Pokemon receives 1/2 damage from sound moves. Its own have 1.3x power.
abilities.Battle Armor: This Pokemon cannot be struck by a critical hit.
abilities.Steely Spirit: This Pokemon and its allies' Steel-type moves have their power multiplied by 1.5.
abilities.Screen Cleaner: On switch-in, the effects of Aurora Veil, Light Screen, and Reflect end for both sides.
abilities.Wandering Spirit: Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon have their Ability swapped with this one.
abilities.Psychic Surge: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Psychic Terrain.
abilities.Hunger Switch: If Morpeko, it changes between Full Belly and Hangry Mode at the end of each turn.
abilities.Seed Sower: When this Pokemon is hit by an attack, the effect of Grassy Terrain begins.
abilities.Purifying Salt: Ghost damage to this Pokemon dealt with a halved offensive stat; can't be statused.
abilities.Electromorphosis: This Pokemon gains the Charge effect when it takes a hit from an attack.
abilities.Guard Dog: Immune to Intimidate. Intimidated: +1 Attack. Cannot be forced to switch out.
abilities.Spicy Spray: If this Pokemon is hit by an attack, the attacker becomes burned.
abilities.Opportunist: When an opposing Pokemon has a stat stage raised, this Pokemon copies the effect.
abilities.Zero to Hero: If this Pokemon is a Palafin in Zero Form, switching out has it change to Hero Form.
abilities.Earth Eater: This Pokemon heals 1/4 of its max HP when hit by Ground moves; Ground immunity.
abilities.Toxic Debris: If this Pokemon is hit by a physical attack, Toxic Spikes are set on the opposing side.
abilities.Fluffy: This Pokemon takes 1/2 damage from contact moves, 2x damage from Fire moves.
abilities.Armor Tail: This Pokemon and its allies are protected from opposing priority moves.
abilities.Supreme Overlord: This Pokemon's moves have 10% more power for each fainted ally, up to 5 allies.
abilities.Thermal Exchange: This Pokemon's Attack is raised by 1 when damaged by Fire moves; can't be burned.
abilities.Good as Gold: This Pokemon is immune to Status moves.
abilities.Hospitality: On switch-in, this Pokemon restores 1/4 of its ally's maximum HP, rounded down.
abilities.Heatproof: Fire damage against this Pokemon is dealt with 1/2 offensive stat; 1/2 burn damage.
abilities.Supersweet Syrup: On switch-in, this Pokemon lowers the evasiveness of opponents 1 stage. Once per battle.
